(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, wherein said columnar body includes a specific cross-sectional shape that differs from the shapes described in Chang.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open and is configured to achieve a novel aesthetic appearance.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are arranged in a non-uniform pattern radially around the columnar body.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises a unique polygonal cross-section that is not explicitly disclosed in Chang.

(Currently Amended) Claim 9: The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides preferentially on each corner of said columnar body arranged to enhance light distribution characteristics.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 120 W/mK.

(Currently Amended) Claim 13: The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises a distinctive proprietary base type not disclosed in Chang.

(Currently Amended) Claim 16: A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 120 W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body, a light emitting diode mounted to at least one side of said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a unique aesthetic profile.
